- letter-spacing, in a range of values
- font-size scaling
- font-weight
- word-spacing
- kerning and text-rendering
- tabular numerals and other OpenType features
- other font families

The CSS, HTML and JS in `site/` look like a stock Bootstrap "Bare" template, with nothing custom that would change the type. I reverted every experiment, so `git status` shows no changes to tracked files.

Here `system-ui`, `sans-serif` and similar names all resolve to Inter through `/etc/fonts/conf.d/56-prefer-inter.conf`. That would be a font or environment difference rather than a regression in the site. I haven't confirmed this, and I didn't touch the system font configuration.
